mapper.sql:
with assetHold as (select gavInfo.finprodAbbr,gavInfo.finprodMarketId,gavInfo.portFolioName, gavInfo.marketValue,gavInfo.dscCostAmt,gavInfo.shareAmt, round(nvl(gavInfo.marketValue,0)/ppvInfo.tdyAssetValue*100,2) as marketValueRatio,gavInfo.portfolioId,ppvInfo.tdyAssetValue, gavInfo.portfolioId1,gavInfo.ptlIssueType,gavInfo.assetRatioTemp from (select psv.CDATE cdate,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId,psv.FINPROD_ID finprodId, psv.MARKET_VALUE marketValue,psv.SHARE_AMT shareAmt,psv.DSC_COST_AMT dscCostAmt, psv.tdy_intincexp tdyIntincexp, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portFolioName,fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr,
T2.RAISE_TYPE ptlIssueType,
pp.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId1,
case when fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F10' and msp.CLOSE_PRICE is not null and msp.C_SHARES is not null then msp.CLOSE_PRICE * msp.C_SHARES when fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F06' and jji.valuation is not null and jji.cShares is not null then jji.valuation * jji.cShares when fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' and mbvi1.price is not null and mbvi1.ISSUE_AMT is not null then mbvi1.price * mbvi1.ISSUE_AMT * 100 when fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' and mbvi2.price is not null and mbvi2.ISSUE_AMT is not null then mbvi2.price * mbvi2.ISSUE_AMT * 100 else null end as assetRatioTemp
from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION psv inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on psv.PORTFOLIO_ID=pp.PORTFOLIO_ID inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID=psv.FINPROD_ID
and fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 != 'F28' and fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 is not null
LEFT JOIN PA_PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T2.PORTFOLIO_ID /*计算资产占比 start*/ /*债券*/ left join( SELECT distinct BOND.VALUE_DATE AS valueDate, BOND.PRICE AS price,/*市价全价*/ BOND.VALUE_SOURCE valueSource, T1.ISSUE_AMT / 10000 ISSUE_AMT,/*发行金额*/ T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T1.TRADE_MARKET TRADE_MARKET FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO BOND INNER join FIN_PRODUCT T1 on T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = BOND.SEC_ID INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(VALUE_DATE) VALUE_DATE, SEC_ID, VALUE_SOURCE FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO
WHERE VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{searchDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY SEC_ID,VALUE_SOURCE ) MAX_DATA ON BOND.SEC_ID = MAX_DATA.SEC_ID AND BOND.VALUE_SOURCE = MAX_DATA.VALUE_SOURCE AND BOND.VALUE_DATE = MAX_DATA.VALUE_DATE WHERE T1.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F01' AND T1.CCY = 'CNY' and BOND.VALUE_SOURCE = 'CBC' ) mbvi1 on mbvi1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = fp.finprod_market_id and fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' and fp.TRADE_MARKET = '01' left join( SELECT distinct BOND.VALUE_DATE AS valueDate, BOND.PRICE AS price,/*市价全价*/ BOND.VALUE_SOURCE valueSource, T1.ISSUE_AMT / 10000 ISSUE_AMT,/*发行金额*/ T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T1.TRADE_MARKET TRADE_MARKET FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO BOND INNER join FIN_PRODUCT T1 on T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = BOND.SEC_ID INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(VALUE_DATE) VALUE_DATE, SEC_ID, VALUE_SOURCE FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO
WHERE VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{searchDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY SEC_ID,VALUE_SOURCE ) MAX_DATA ON BOND.SEC_ID = MAX_DATA.SEC_ID AND BOND.VALUE_SOURCE = MAX_DATA.VALUE_SOURCE AND BOND.VALUE_DATE = MAX_DATA.VALUE_DATE WHERE T1.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F01' AND T1.CCY = 'CNY' and BOND.VALUE_SOURCE = 'CSD' ) mbvi2 on mbvi1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = fp.finprod_market_id and fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' and fp.TRADE_MARKET = '01' /*基金*/ left join( SELECT P.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, V.VAL_DATE valDate, V.VALUATION valuation, /*单位净值*/ V.C_SHARES cShares /*基金行情总份额值*/ FROM FIN_PRODUCT P INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION V ON P.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = V.FINPROD_ID and p.FINPROD_TYPE = V.FINPROD_TYPE INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE TYPE ON P.FINPROD_ID = TYPE.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(VAL_DATE) VAL_DATE, FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION
WHERE VAL_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{searchDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY FINPROD_ID ) MAX_DATA ON V.FINPROD_ID = MAX_DATA.FINPROD_ID AND V.VAL_DATE = MAX_DATA.VAL_DATE LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO CUST ON CUST.CUSTOMER_ID = P.MANAGER AND CUST.IS_ASSTE_MANAGER = 'Y' WHERE P.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F06' ) jji
on jji.finprodMarketId=fp.finprod_market_id and fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F06'
/*股票*/ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T.* FROM mst_share_price T INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(DEAL_DATE) DEAL_DATE, shares_id FROM mst_share_price
WHERE DEAL_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{searchDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY shares_id ) T1 ON T1.DEAL_DATE = T.DEAL_DATE AND T.shares_id = T1.shares_id ) msp on msp.shares_id = fp.finprod_market_id and fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F10' /*计算资产占比 end*/
where 1=1
AND fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID IN
#{item}
and to_char(psv.CDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{searchDate}
)gavInfo left join (select ppv.CDATE cdate,ppv.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId,nvl(ppv.TDY_ASSET_VALUE,0) tdyAssetValue from PTL_PORTFOLIO_VALUATION ppv where 1=1
and to_char(ppv.CDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd')= #{searchDate}
)ppvInfo on ppvInfo.portfolioId=gavInfo.portfolioId and ppvInfo.cdate=gavInfo.cdate where ppvInfo.tdyAssetValue !=0 )

select.if: select finprodMarketId,finprodAbbr,null portFolioName,sum(marketValue) as marketValue, sum(dscCostAmt) as dscCostAmt,sum(shareAmt) as shareAmt, round(sum(nvl(assetHold.marketValue,0))/sum(assetHold.tdyAssetValue)*100,2) as marketValueRatio,null portfolioId,'02' as hasChildren ,'root' parentInfo,finprodMarketId childInfo,portfolioId1,ptlIssueType from assetHold group by finprodMarketId,finprodAbbr,portfolioId1

select null finprodMarketId,null finprodAbbr,portFolioName,marketValue,dscCostAmt,shareAmt, marketValueRatio,portfolioId,'01' as hasChildren ,finprodMarketId parentInfo,portFolioName childInfo,portfolioId1 from assetHold where finprodMarketId = #{parentId}

select finprodMarketId,finprodAbbr,null portFolioName,sum(marketValue) as marketValue, sum(dscCostAmt) as dscCostAmt,sum(shareAmt) as shareAmt, sum(marketValueRatio) as marketValueRatio,null portfolioId,'02' as hasChildren ,'root' parentInfo,finprodMarketId childInfo,portfolioId1,ptlIssueType from assetHold group by finprodMarketId,finprodAbbr,portfolioId1

INNER JOIN DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST dani on dani.BUSINESS_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID AND dani.MODEL_TYPE='02'
AND dani.INSTITUTION_CODE IN
#{item}
WHERE FINPROD_TYPE2 in
#{item}
AND (FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR FINPROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR FINPROD_ABBR LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')))

SELECT ASSET_CODE id, ASSET_NAME text FROM RSK_ASSET_INFO
AND (ASSET_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR ASSET_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) )
